literal: Rain enduring, world functioning because of continuing, itself ambrosia that is to be understood.
translation: Because the world continues to function only through the endurance of rain, rain itself is to be understood as the nectar of immortality.
modern: மழை நிலைபெற்று பெய்வதால்தான் இந்த உலகம் தொடர்ந்து இயங்கி வருகிறது; ஆகையால் மழையே அமிழ்தம் என்று உணரத்தக்கது.
explanation: This couplet establishes rain as the life-sustaining force of the earth. The word 'வான்' literally means sky, but in this context it stands for the rain that falls from it. The phrase 'நின்று வழங்கி வருதலால்' describes how the world continues to function and thrive because the rain endures and reliably provides for it. Because all earthly life depends entirely on this continuous cycle, rain itself ('தான்') is equated to 'அமிழ்தம்' (ambrosia), the mythical nectar of immortality. The concluding word 'உணரற்பாற்று' indicates that this is a fundamental truth of nature that one must realize.
